interpretation.emerging_direction_accuracy: Fraction of skills predicted Emerging (FDR q<0.05, slope≥0.05) where mean TEST frequency > last TRAIN month frequency. Target: > 0.60
interpretation.slope_correlation: Pearson r between TRAIN regression slope and actual TEST frequency delta. Measures whether the pipeline's growth estimate is calibrated. Target: > 0.30
interpretation.precision_emerging_significant_test: Fraction of Emerging predictions with a statistically significant positive slope in the TEST window (p < 0.10).
